nodes.label: TipTap / y-prosemirror compatibility (marks, missing attrs)
nodes.rationale: iOS (Yrs) must read and write exactly what y-prosemirror writes; writers pass explicit attributes because Yjs/Yrs insert inherits formatting from the left; missing attribute means null.

nodes.label: Rule: never delete unknown content
nodes.rationale: Web editor deleted agent code blocks on open

nodes.label: Single Title and Repair Rules
nodes.rationale: Clients wrote an empty title into not-yet-received notes; after merge the real title became a paragraph

nodes.label: SharedRef.order: новая запись order = min − 1, при равенстве — новее addedAt
Inline nodes and marks (noteLink, tag, agentEdit, link)
notebook document (index)
nodes.rationale: meta holds a copy of notebook/space names, icon and color from the account doc (invisible to server) so agents see names and the consent screen can color the icon.

nodes.label: SharedRef (openedAt, order)
nodes.rationale: Ordered by order ascending, new entries get min-1 so newest is on top; spaceId is legacy for compatibility only; openedAt marks first open on any device so 'new' bold state is consistent across web, iPhone, iPad.

nodes.label: trust record (flat keys)
nodes.rationale: Flat keys so writes from two devices never overwrite each other; clients only append.

nodes.label: Rule: one title, repair on open
nodes.rationale: Clients wrote empty titles into not-yet-synced notes
